column3: Kirino Route · For My Little Sister To Ignore Me Isn't...Is Possible
Huh? A song that I composed?!
Just what exactly is so interesting about preparing such a stupid thing in order to tell a lie like that?
It's not about whether it's interesting or not! I'm just speaking the truth!
You have no persuasive power.
Believe in me.
...Then, you're saying this is something I made?
*sigh*... She's finally willing to believe me?
As if!
I'll say it once more. This was made by you.
No, no, no! That's impossible!
Y-You... Are you just going to completely deny it without any basis for it?
...How annoying...
The voice in the song belongs to you, right? How do you explain that?
Although that's the case, isn't it possible to edit or synthesize voices on the computer?
Isn't this the kind of method that swindlers and kidnappers often use?
Don't say it like I'm a criminal!
Then quickly produce the evidence that proves that you're not a criminal. Come on.
There isn't such a thing. Then, let me ask you instead, why would I forge evidence?
Huh? It's really gross to argue for argument's sake, you know?
It's you that's arguing for argument's sake!
Are you for real? There's no way I could possess such skills.
But, aren't otakus experts in that field?
There are also many types of otakus. Wait, are you saying I'm an otaku now?!
Whoa～... Now you're saying you're not one? That's too late.
If I were an otaku, that would be rude to the real otakus all over the country!
Besides, I don't have my own computer. How am I supposed to create these sounds?
How am I supposed to know about that?
Rather, are you seriously saying that I'm the one who made this song?
If so, I'm not going to be able to take you seriously, you know?
What are you saying?! Playing innocent when it comes to your own hobby...!
Huh? What hobby?
Like I've said, you have many otaku goods that you've hidden inside your room. This song too is an extension of your hobby.
Could it be that you're acting dumb on purpose?
Your comments are making me shrink away...
Huh, what? Have I said anything wrong?
Don't be so defiant. I'm telling you, I'm really not lying. I'll even take an oath.
Then, if you're lying, die.
...I don't mind. If you can recover your memories that way.
Wha-?!
Just acknowledge it already! This song really was composed by you!
Like～I～said, didn't I say that I don't remember anything about this!
Just remember it already! You definitely should be able to remember it! You really liked this song!
You too, isn't it about time you cut it out?
No matter how much I deny it, you're just persistently hanging on to it.
It's like you're brainwashing me!
Eh?! EH?!
Y-You actually mentioned brainwashing...
...Stop joking with me.
You too, stop joking with me. You've been babbling persistently since earlier on...
Ah geez...This is so irritating!
Y-you're just all empty talk...
In any case, I don't remember making a song like this!
...Are you serious? You're still denying it even with such direct proof right in front of you?
Don't make me keep repeating myself. Rather, I'm tired of having to tell you I'm being honest, but still having to listen to you.
